method.analysis: Use the existing sample-clock-preserving 1024-sample square-root Hann transform with 256 sample hop. Propose up to three fixed interchannel lag modes on the submitted six-second track, from -22 through 22 samples. Score summed positive phase agreement cubed over 250–2400 Hz, weighted by square root of cross-channel magnitude and capped at its 85th percentile. Require local lag maxima, four samples of separation, a second peak at least 0.38 of the strongest and nondegenerate joint covariance.
method.comparison: Native mono and prior AuxIVA maximum, independently frozen on the ordinary Surrey set. Use the same two-second windows and speech gate for the new direction masks. Score each anonymous output separately and take the largest admitted response. In the additive comparison keep all mono findings.
method.gate: Require at least two net additional useful held edit source groups across two generator families, no added background-only flagged group in any layout, and at most one added ordinary flagged group in each layout. A pass on reused recordings supports fresh transfer only. All outputs are anonymous and no candidate contributes to the service score.
method.masks: Seed per-frequency complex two-channel angular Gaussian scatter matrices with each phase-aligned broadband lag and its weighted relative amplitude, limited to plus or minus 12 dB. Eight weighted EM updates on unit channel vectors. Shrink 20% of normalized covariance back to the fixed frequency-specific seed and blend 15% equal mixture weights. Use masks from 125–6400 Hz with nearest fitted edge masks outside. Reconstruct the mixture mean through each mask with unchanged native clock, unity total and no normalizing gain. Decline clipped views and those with less than 1.5% of mixture energy.
method.timing: Pick the strongest admitted response with the earlier window breaking ties. Require at least 0.30 interval IoU and coverage of at least half the authored edit for a useful result. Report repeated source groups by layout, false ordinary clips and groups, misplaced flags, unassessed windows, and equal ordinary-group ranking as retrospective only.
